about_the_game:
Chains on Sand Demo lets you experience the brutal heart of the arena—test your skills, shape your fighter, and survive in a world where every battle matters.
This demo offers a taste of the full game’s gritty, tactical combat and dark fantasy atmosphere. Perfect for roguelike fans and those who love high-stakes, skill-based gameplay!

What’s Included in the Demo:

  • Full character creation: Choose your race, assign stats, select traits, and customize your contender’s appearance.

  • Core turn-based arena combat: Engage in challenging battles against AI opponents with distinct fighting styles and personalities.

  • Crowd Judgement: Face tough decisions as the crowd demands mercy or blood—your choices affect your popularity and future rewards.

  • Loot and progression: Earn new equipment by defeating opponents, and see if you can survive multiple matches in a row.

  • Popularity and legacy system: Win the crowd, build your reputation, and try to make your mark in the arena’s history.

  • High score table: Compete against yourself or others for the best run—how far can you get?

Demo Limitations:

  • Limited to the first set of arena fights (the full game will offer deeper progression, more opponents, and additional features).

  • Some advanced systems (legendary equipment, consumables, legendary opponents fights, legacy system) are only available in the final release.

Feedback Welcome!

Chains on Sand is an evolving project—your thoughts, bug reports, and suggestions are crucial to making the final game the best it can be. Join the discussion and let us know what you think!

Step into the arena.
Survive if you can.
Make the crowd remember your name.

content_descriptors.notes: The demo contains fantasy depictions of violence and some blood.
